resumeText:
Sneha Reddy | Hyderabad | sneha.reddy@example.com

EXPERIENCE

- Log every call, email and meeting in HubSpot CRM and keep deal stages up to date.

- Booked 14 qualified meetings a month on average over the last year.

Customer Support Associate, Brightdesk Services, Hyderabad (2022 - 2023)

Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Excel
